name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Artist Matthew Taylor Is Helping Trump Reshape Washington
changes.summary: Matthew Taylor, a conceptual artist and political strategist, made influential ads and documentaries produced by Steve Bannon. Now he’s assisting the White House.

changes.title: Secret Service warns of high threat levels before White House Correspondents' Dinner
changes.summary: Secret Service officials warned nationwide threats have reached an unprecedented level since January, nearly 40% higher than during the same period last year.

changes.title: Inside the heightened security for the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner
changes.summary: The Secret Service says there has been a significant rise in threats ahead of the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner. CBS News' Nicole Sganga has more details.

changes.title: Trump expected to attend White House Correspondents' Dinner redo after April attack
changes.summary: President Trump is expected to attend the redo of the White House Correspondents' Dinner on Friday night after an armed assailant upended April's dinner.

changes.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford says "we didn't start this trade war" as Trump slaps Canada with tariffs
changes.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford spoke with CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe about the upcoming opening of the Gordie Howe Bridge and President Trump's new tariffs on Canada. "We didn't start this trade war. President Trump decided to go after his close ally and friend, his number one custome.

changes.title: Trump says "nobody got out ahead" of him on Saudi nuclear deal announcement after changing terms
changes.summary: President Trump took questions from reporters the day after he seemed to upend a nuclear agreement with Saudi Arabia by adding a new condition: that the country join the Abraham Accords. CBS News White House reporter Olivia Rinaldi has the details.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 24 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02332-8 Chief US science adviser calls for a shakeup in funding while handing out grants to accelerate research with AI.

changes.title: White House Correspondents’ Dinner Returns Under High Security
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is gearing up to attend the rescheduled White House Correspondents Dinner Friday night, after the initial event back in April was targeted by a gunman. The Secret Service says it’s confident in the security plan for the dinner while also acknowledging an alarming rise in threats. NBC’s Garrett Ha.

changes.title: Trump takes questions on Iran and cyclosporiasis outbreak during White House event
changes.summary: During an event on nuclear innovation, President Trump fielded questions from reporters on the war with Iran and threats about potential targets and the outbreak of cyclosporiasis. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on what the president had to say about the issues facing the administration.

changes.title: Trump touts new nuclear reactors in his push to speed up domestic power
changes.summary: President Donald Trump hosted executives from nuclear power companies Friday in the Oval Office to celebrate a new milestone in the White House's push to accelerate the growth of nuclear power in the United States.
